llm_response.reason: The website displays unusually low prices and claims of 'free shipping,' pretends to be the official Mexican distributor for Adidas Yeezy products, and mimics legitimate Adidas branding. Its WHOIS registrant is an individual in Germany, not an established Mexican business partner or Adidas entity. These signal typical fake shopping scam tactics: spoofing a well-known brand, implausible offers, misleading privacy/ownership and no legitimate company contact details.
